summary: Preserve committed history while Bitcoin Core restores its tip after a restart
details: Balance-history separates the canonical Bitcoin tip from the confirmation target. A lower target, matching shorter history or failed RPC query gates readiness with UpstreamRecoveryPending while retaining committed data; recovery resumes automatically without advancing the indexer reorg epoch.

Conflicting committed block hashes still trigger reorg reconciliation and the existing durable chain protection. Restart regressions cover both unchanged history recovery and real replacement branches.

Known but unreadable chain incident files are retried through the existing bounded read-only container probe so status can display their details. Failed probes preserve the known critical incident and never clear a halt marker.
operator_actions: Upgrade and restart balance-history through the normal release workflow. If DEEP_REORG_HALTED was already recorded, preserve the incident and follow the reviewed recovery procedure; this fix does not automatically unlock an existing halt.
